description_en: Queries the Browser Monitoring data based on a query statement of Log Service
description_zh: 根据SLS的查询语句查询前端监控的数据
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-retcode-data-by-query --pid atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf0000 --query t_:_pv_select_sum_times_as_pv_,_approx_distinct_uid_as_uv_,_date-date%3600000_as_date_group_by_date --from 1668687302 --to 1668688000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRetcodeDataByQuery

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application.

Log on to the ARMS console. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Browser Monitoring > Browser Monitoring. On the Browser Monitoring page, click the name of an application. The URL in the address bar contains the process ID (PID) of the application. The PID is indicated in the pid=xxx format. The PID is usually percent encoded as xxx%40xxx. You must modify this value to remove the percent encoding. For example, if the PID in the URL is eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d\\, you must replace %40 with an at sign (@) to obtain eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d\\
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的前端监控 > 前端列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含前端应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，应用需要对xxx%40xxx格式的pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****，则需要将%40替换为@，即：eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.name: pid

parameters.example: t : pv|select sum(times) as pv , approx_distinct(uid) as uv , (date-date%3600000) as date  group by date
parameters.help_en: The query statement that conforms to the query syntax of a Log Service Logstore
parameters.help_zh: 符合SLS Logstore查询语法的查询语句
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to
